title: Add Floating Left-Side Call Button to TrustFix Website

requirements.summary: Create a FloatingCallButton component with circular green design, phone icon, fixed middle-left positioning, hover effects, click-to-call functionality, mobile long-press support, tooltip, and responsive sizing
acceptanceCriteria: Button is circular with #25D366 background and a white phone icon
Button is fixed at middle-left of the viewport and does not scroll with the page
Clicking the button initiates a call to tel:8884447229
Long-pressing the button on mobile (≥500ms) also triggers the call
A tooltip reading 'Call TrustFix' appears on hover and focus
Button has a visible drop shadow and scales up smoothly on hover
Button size is 52px on mobile and 60px on desktop

file_operations.description: Create a new React component that renders a circular, fixed-position call button on the middle-left of the screen. The button must use `position: fixed; left: 1rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%)` for positioning, have a #25D366 background color, contain a white phone SVG icon, and include a drop shadow. Implement a smooth scale-up hover effect using CSS transitions. On click, trigger `window.location.href = 'tel:8884447229'`. For mobile long-press support, use pointerdown and pointerup events with a 500ms timer. Include `aria-label='Call TrustFix'` for accessibility. Add a tooltip that displays 'Call TrustFix' on hover and focus states. Make the button size responsive: 52px (w-13 h-13) on mobile and 60px (md:w-15 md:h-15) on desktop using Tailwind classes. Ensure the button has sufficient z-index to stay above other content.

requirements.summary: Integrate FloatingCallButton into Layout.tsx alongside the existing FloatingWhatsAppButton with proper positioning to prevent overlap and maintain safe margins on mobile
acceptanceCriteria: Call button (left) and WhatsApp button (right) do not overlap on any screen size
Both buttons maintain at least 80px clearance from the bottom on mobile
No existing design elements are altered

file_operations.description: Import and add the FloatingCallButton component alongside the existing FloatingWhatsAppButton. The FloatingCallButton will position itself on the middle-left, while the FloatingWhatsAppButton remains in the bottom-right. Verify that both buttons maintain at least 80px clearance from the bottom on mobile viewports to avoid conflicts with bottom navigation bars. Since the call button uses middle-left positioning and the WhatsApp button uses bottom-right positioning, they should naturally avoid overlap. Ensure no changes are made to the existing FloatingWhatsAppButton component or any other Layout elements such as Navbar, Footer, or the watermark background.
